# Objective

Reshape five error-stats outputs to one-row-per-reference (or long
ref/alt) tables with per-sequence rates, then release v0.7.0 and deploy
to sibio.

# New schemas

| Output | Columns |
|---|---|
| `deletion` | seq_name, total, del_a..del_t, del_a_rate..del_t_rate |
| `insertion` | seq_name, total, ins_a..ins_t, ins_a_rate..ins_t_rate |
| `mismatch` | seq_name, ref, alt, count, rate |
| `per_base` | seq_name, total, insertion, deletion, mismatch, insertion_rate, deletion_rate, mismatch_rate |
| `per_read` | same shape as per_base (rates vs total reads) |

# Interpretations (stated)

- Every rate normalizes inside the sequence: `del_x_rate = del_x /
  total` with `total` the per-seq event total (`per_base_summary`
  insertions/deletions/mismatches); `0.0` on zero total.
- N bases stay hidden: `del_*`/`ins_*` show A/C/G/T only (N counted in
  `total`); mismatch rows are A/C/G/T x A/C/G/T, diagonal (ref==alt)
  skipped — 12 dense rows per reference, zeros included.
- per_base total = aligned bases; per_read total = tallied reads; the
  old `substitution` label becomes `mismatch`.
- `error`, `single_deletion`, `ref_summary` outputs are unchanged.
- TypedStats stays (annotate AP/NB tag stats still use it);
  MismatchMatrixStats is removed.

# Scope

- `parquet_writer.py`: new `IndelCompositionStats` (prefix param),
  `PerRefCountsStats`, `MismatchLongStats`; remove `MismatchMatrixStats`.
- `stats/error_stats.py`: rewrite `_write_{insertion,deletion,per_read,
  per_base,mismatch}_stats`.
- `cli.py` + `docs/usage.qmd`: update the output table/help.
- Tests: parquet_writer matrix tests replaced; integration + qc-summary
  per_base readers updated; new value assertions in test_stats.
- Version 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0; release; conda-recipes meta.yaml 0.7.0 + new
  sha256; build-meta; sibio deploy; verify; audit pair; report.

# Verification criteria

1. Full suite + lint + pyright green; smoke run shows the new schemas.
2. `sam-tagger --version` -> 0.7.0; release carries wheel + sdist.
3. sibio resolves 0.7.0; fresh-env install verifies.
